one_liner: Kind-hearted pushover who can't say no, quietly burning to finally be the 'lead role' for once.
personality: A soft, helpful 'nice girl' (tagline: お人よし) who gets dragged around by her flashier friends, does their chores, and keeps the peace with sweets. Beneath that she is fixated on becoming the 主役 -- the star of the story -- and keeps psyching herself up while admitting she was once cast as a tree in a school play. Polite and self-deprecating, she relies on effort ('my only strength is that I can keep trying') and lights up into a genuine fire when racing.

story_arc.summary: Dantsu runs the Classic route (Kisaragi Sho, Satsuki Sho, Japan Derby, Kikka Sho) against a dazzling generation, with event titles framing her as the 'shadow lead' ('菊花賞の後に・影の主役'). In her senior year she targets the Mile CS, Niigata Daishoten, Yasuda Kinen, Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Japan Cup, building toward the spotlight ('宝塚記念の後に・スポットライトの輝き', 'ジャパンCの後に・“時代の主役”') -- the story of a supporting character becoming the protagonist.
story_arc.source: event titles; real-life Takarazuka Kinen win is general knowledge (unverified)
